profile.name: Masterflex 蠕动泵
profile.description: 一种可通过串口通信控制的实验室蠕动泵，用于连续输液、定时分配和批量加液。该设备可控制启停、转速、转向、分配模式和运行时间，并可记录体积与批次数，常用于试剂输送、流路控制和自动化液体处理。
profile.description_en: A laboratory peristaltic pump that can be controlled through serial communication for continuous pumping, timed dispensing, and batch liquid delivery. It supports control of start/stop, speed, direction, dispense mode, and run time, and can track volume and batch counts for reagent transfer, fluid-path control, and automated liquid handling.
